messages:
samir: Hey team, first day. Trying to run the app with docker-compose + Colima. Postgres container is up but app logs ECONNREFUSED to localhost:5432. I tried host.docker.internal and localhost, nothing works. Any tips?

elaine: Welcome! Quick question: is your app running inside a container or on your host? If inside a container, `localhost` points to that container. host.docker.internal sometimes works but is flaky with Colima.

samir: App runs in a container. Compose excerpt: ```services:
  pg: 
    image: postgres:14
    ports: ["5432:5432"]
  api:
    build: .
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:pw@localhost:5432/app_dev
    depends_on: [pg]```

tom: Swap `localhost` -> `pg` in DATABASE_URL so inter-container DNS is used: `postgres://postgres:pw@pg:5432/app_dev`. Also consider adding a healthcheck for pg and a tiny retry in the api entrypoint; `depends_on` doesn't wait for readiness.

elaine: If you need the host to connect (e.g., psql from your laptop), publish the port and use `localhost:5432` on the Mac. With Colima you might need `colima ssh` or check `colima status` if port forwarding is misconfigured. But inside containers prefer service name.

samir: Changing to `pg` fixed the connection. I added a `healthcheck` and a `wait-for` loop in entrypoint to avoid race. Thanks! :smile:

infra-bot: Dev docs: update pushed with Colima + host.docker.internal notes and recommended compose patterns: https://redwood-inference.internal/docs/dev-setup#local-db (cc @new-hires)
